raw: I remember seeing a split trash bag outside the garage. There were fish scraps scattered over the pavement, and flies were circling the open bag. That was what really disgusted me—the fish lying out in the open with the flies around it. My attention kept going between the torn bag and the scraps on the ground. I didn’t want to get close to any of it. I was thinking what an unpleasant mess it was and how horrible it would be to have to pick it all up.
